import html from typing import List # Predefined template for a user post. The placeholders will be replaced # by the escaped values of username, title, body and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {username}

{body}
{tag_elements}
""" def render_user_content( username_key: str, title_key: str, body_key: str, tag_elements: List[str] ) -> str: """ Generate an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a user’s forum post. Parameters ---------- username_key : str Identifier (username) of the post’s creator. title_key : str Title/heading of the user’s post. body_key : str Primary content of the post. tag_elements : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing safe, escaped HTML for the user post. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments are missing or not strings. """ # Basic type checking if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (username_key, title_key, body_key)): raise ValueError("Username, title and body must be strings.") if not isinstance(tag_elements, list): raise ValueError("tag_elements must be a list of strings.") if not all(isinstance(tag, str) for tag in tag_elements): raise ValueError("All tags must be strings.") # Escape user supplied data to neutralize special characters safe_username = html.escape(username_key, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title_key, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body_key, quote=True) # Wrap each tag in a element and escape the tag text escaped_tags = [] for tag in tag_elements: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) escaped_tags.append(f'{escaped_tag}') safe_tag_elements = " ".join(escaped_tags) # Construct the final HTML using the template rendered_html = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tag_elements=safe_tag_elements ) return rendered_html.strip()
